nodes.n: Harsh Malhotra's office. Glass walls, the whole city below, and a TV on mute playing the video on a loop.

nodes.t: My daughter. In a slum. With a team of... street girls. And my twelfth man.
Explain this to me in a way that doesn't end your contract.

choice.t: "It's her academy, sir. She built it herself. You should be proud."
"I just batted. I didn't know who she was."

nodes.n: The door opens. Kunal walks in, all smiles, phone in hand.

nodes.t: Sir, I can explain. It was MY idea. I sent the rookie. Charity cricket, good optics for the wedding. I didn't want to tell Meera it was my surprise.
...Charity. Good. Very good. Then we'll put out a statement. The captain's charity initiative.

nodes.n: In the corridor Kunal stops you with one hand on your chest.

nodes.t: I just saved your career, small town. Now you owe me. And I collect.
Your contract has a trade clause. The Falcons asked about you last week. One word from me and you're in Delhi by Friday.

msgs.t: Now it's HIS charity. His face on the posters.
And he's going to have you traded. I heard him on the phone.
I'm sorry. This is my fault.

choice.t: "Let him trade me. I'm not walking away from you."
"Then we stop. Before he hurts you too."

nodes.t: Team sheet's up for Sunday. Rookie... you're not on it. Not even twelfth man. There's a note next to your name: "Trade window."

nodes.cliff: The trade window closes Friday. Kunal holds the pen.
